meta.notes: staleThresholdDays and minSampleSize must match analytics/calculations/core.ts (STALE_THRESHOLD_DAYS, MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE) — this file documents the values the engine actually uses, it does not independently configure them. A handful of questions from the original 110-item brief are intentionally merged into one catalogue entry where the question text was a literal repeat across sections (e.g. 'total delivered revenue' appeared under both Executive Overview and Revenue & Deal Value) — each still appears once, in its primary section, and is fully searchable.
